newsitem.title: USA: Packaging Plus seeks $14 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Packaging Plus seeks $14 mln in financing.

text.p: Packaging Plus Services Inc said Thursday it had retained a Miami investment banking firm to arrange $14 million in financing for its acquisition plans.

The company, which provides packaging, shipping and other services, said the amount to be arranged by Select Capital Advisors will include up to $7 million in term debt, $1.8 million in convertible high yield bonds, and up to $5 million in equipment leasing.

"Select has already received a commitment for $1,750,000 of convertible bonds from a single investor, of which $250,000 has been funded, with the remaining funding to come in a series of traunches over the next few months," it said in a statement.
